architectural_fidelity.reason: Room architecture is preserved: same wall configuration, ceiling height with crown molding, window position on right, fireplace location maintained, camera viewpoint consistent, dark gray side walls intact

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with clean floor surfaces, no ghost outlines or remnants visible, radiator cover removed successfully

style_commitment.reason: Strong Art Deco commitment evident through dramatic black marble feature wall with gold veining and brass geometric panel detailing, Art Deco fan motif in fireplace niche, period-appropriate luxe materials and metallic accents

editorial_density.reason: Room is essentially empty staging with only two decorative vessels in fireplace niche; lacks furniture, textiles, layered accessories, plants, multiple light sources, and lived-in vignettes required for editorial standard

photorealism.reason: Excellent material realism in marble veining and wood flooring, coherent natural lighting from window, proper shadow behavior, no CGI plasticity

designer_preference_reason: Despite Cova's superior style execution, the complete lack of furnishings makes it unusable for client presentation compared to Collov's fully staged, move-in ready visualization
what_cova_does_better: Dramatically superior style commitment with authentic Art Deco vocabulary
Luxurious material palette with black marble and brass detailing
Maintains architectural integrity while transforming aesthetic
Photorealistic rendering quality of surfaces and lighting
what_collov_does_better: Complete room staging with furniture and functional layout
Editorial density with layered textiles, art, plants, and accessories
Multiple light sources and styling vignettes
specific_fixes_if_failing: Add complete furniture layout: Art Deco sofa, accent chairs, cocktail table in appropriate scale
Layer in minimum 3-4 textiles: velvet cushions, geometric throws, area rug
Include wall art or mirrors with Art Deco frames
Add plants, table lamps, decorative objects, books to create lived-in density
Stage fireplace mantel with symmetrical Art Deco accessories
